en: Relying on expensive GPU hardware upgrades to brute-force I/O stalls

failureConditions.en: If host memory bandwidth saturates or disk read latency spikes, pipeline engages cached chunk prefetching to prevent GPU idling.
failureConditions.zh-TW: 若主機記憶體頻寬飽和或磁碟讀取延遲增加，管線啟用快取分塊預取機制，防止 GPU 算力閒置。

challenger.en: Why not simply scale up GPU memory or rent a larger cluster to brute-force training throughput?
challenger.zh-TW: 為什麼不直接堆疊更多 GPU 顯存或租用雲端叢集暴力解決訓練吞吐？

defense.en: Adding more compute GPUs does not solve a host CPU data-ingestion bottleneck—it only amplifies GPU idle time. By isolating format deserialization stalls and building an asynchronous pipeline, we unlocked ~10× throughput on existing hardware with zero added capex.
defense.zh-TW: 增加 GPU 算力無法解決主機端的資料載入阻塞，只會讓高價 GPU 閒置等待。透過定位格式反序列化瓶頸並建立非同步管線，我們在既有硬體上釋放約 10 倍訓練吞吐，達成零硬體增購支出。

challenger.en: How did you structure the workflow when leveraging AI code assistance for loader refactoring?
challenger.zh-TW: 在利用 AI 輔助改寫資料載入器時，你如何把控工程架構與程式碼品質？

defense.en: As Senior AI Engineer, I conducted the profiler diagnosis, specified asynchronous prefetching and caching architectures, and reviewed generated code line-by-line to guarantee numerical fidelity and interface stability.
defense.zh-TW: 由我主導系統 profiling 瓶頸分析、確立非同步預取與快取架構規範，並對 AI 協同生成的程式碼進行逐行審查，嚴格確保數值計算精度與介面穩定性。
